lockup.summary: Directors, officers and nearly all other holders agree not to sell shares for 180 days after the prospectus date. The lead underwriters can allow sales sooner by written consent, with some exceptions.

what: Scribe Therapeutics develops CRISPR gene-editing medicines meant to prevent and treat common heart and metabolic diseases.
risks: It is a young company that has not finished any clinical trial and has no approved product, so its future is hard to judge.
It has lost money every period since it started, has no product revenue, and expects losses to continue.
Its management and auditors have serious doubt it can keep operating, because current cash will not last twelve months.
Even after this offering, it will need a lot more money, which may not be available on acceptable terms.
